difficulty_reason: The reduction realizes a sparse tripartite graph by four layers of radius-1/2 balls in three dimensions. The author controls trigonometric coordinate gaps and squared distances so adjacent layers encode exactly the graph incidences, handles RAM precision, and proves the diameter-2/diameter-3 equivalence. This complete geometric encoding is the independent hardness result; no support observation or algorithm result is split.
